misprints.probably_meant: μορμολύττεσθαί τι (enclitic accent, correct as printed)
misprints.note: Kept as printed; the corpus flag comes from the enclitic accent.

uncertain.note: The endings εῖα and ύ have no breathing in the print; the accent on ύ is small and could not be fully confirmed.
όν has no clear breathing in the print, so it is copied as όν.
